outputs.from_the_caption: Schematic of hESC 3D EB differentiation protocol.
outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram, not a data plot; no statistical test is applicable.

outputs.from_the_caption: Western blots of receptor-SMADs 6 h after small molecule addition.
outputs.explanation: Panel B shows western blot images, not a quantitative plot with statistics, and no significance is claimed.

outputs.from_the_caption: RT-qPCR analysis of marker gene expression in a differentiation time-course. Data are represented as mean ± SEM (n = 3–4) independent biological experiments for (C, F, G).
outputs.explanation: Panel C shows mean ± SEM time-course curves with no significance asterisks, p-values, or comparison markers, so no statistical test needs to be named.

outputs.from_the_caption: Live imaging of SOX17-Tom and NKX2-5-GFP at 3 timepoints of differentiation.
outputs.explanation: Panel D consists of representative micrographs, not a statistical plot.

outputs.from_the_caption: Representative flow cytometric analyses of surface markers PDGFRα and CD235, together with SOX17-Tom and NKX2-5-GFP.
outputs.explanation: Panel E shows representative flow cytometry dot plots with percentage gates, not a statistical comparison with significance markers.

outputs.from_the_caption: Positive cell proportions for day 4. Data are represented as mean ± SEM (n = 3–4) independent biological experiments.
outputs.explanation: Panel F shows mean ± SEM curves across conditions with no significance asterisks or p-values indicated, so no statistical test needs to be reported.

outputs.from_the_caption: Positive cell proportions for day 7.5. Data are represented as mean ± SEM (n = 3–4) independent biological experiments.
outputs.explanation: Panel G shows mean ± SEM curves across conditions with no significance asterisks or p-values indicated, so no statistical test needs to be reported.

outputs.from_the_caption: Immunostaining of whole mount EBs stained for FOXA2, α-actinin and WT1.
outputs.explanation: Panel H shows representative immunofluorescence images, not a statistical plot.

outputs.from_the_caption: RNA-seq quantifications of NKX2-5 and FOXA2 after sorting of 8 populations. Boxplots follow standard Tukey representations (n = 3 independent biological experiments).
outputs.explanation: Panel I shows Tukey boxplots of expression across sorted populations with no significance asterisks, p-values, or pairwise comparison markers, so no statistical test needs to be named.

outputs.from_the_caption: Hierarchical clustering of cell type and lineage markers based on RNA-seq data, expressed as Z-score normalized log2 FC differences.
outputs.explanation: Panel J is a hierarchical clustering heatmap, not a statistical significance plot.
